best_existing.name: intellectronica/ruler
best_existing.covers: One canonical rules source rendered into each agent's instruction file (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), including nested apply

best_existing.name: dyoshikawa/rulesync
best_existing.covers: CLI that generates and syncs rules, skills, commands, MCP and hooks configs across many coding agents

best_existing.name: Claude Code native AGENTS.md support (v2.1.277)
best_existing.covers: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md exists; configurable 'Project instructions' setting can load both; subdirectory CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md load on demand (documented at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)

best_existing.name: Topicspot/rulereach
best_existing.covers: Linter that reports which agent instruction files (nested AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md imports, Cursor globs) will never be loaded

shortcomings.what: Codex still does not dynamically load nested AGENTS.md as work moves into subtrees, and gives no visibility into which instruction files are active; issue open with enterprise customers (Stripe, Wix, Reddit, Palantir) attached
Claude Code still does not load skills from .agents/skills (new request filed Nov 2026); umbrella issue remains open
Claude Code's AGENTS.md support is fallback-only by default and InstructionsLoaded hooks do not fire for AGENTS.md read through the setting, so visibility tooling misses it
Symlinking CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md loads both files, duplicating content
Ruler gives no warning when generated AGENTS.md exceeds Codex's 32 KiB limit, so the tail of the instructions is silently dropped
Ruler nested apply ignores child settings

note: Generators (Ruler, rulesync) handle cross-agent fan-out and Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md, but nested-file loading and 'which rules did the agent actually get' remain gaps, especially in Codex. Sync tools also have silent-truncation and nested-apply bugs.

best_existing.name: GitLab Duo Agent Platform external agents (Claude Code Agent, Codex Agent)
best_existing.covers: Mention or assign a service account in GitLab issues/MRs to run GitLab-managed Claude Code or Codex agents that push branches and MRs

best_existing.name: Cursor Cloud Agents forge integrations
best_existing.covers: Cloud agents work with GitHub, GitLab (incl. self-hosted), Azure DevOps Services and Bitbucket Cloud

best_existing.name: cyrusagents/cyrus
best_existing.covers: Self-hostable Claude Code (and Codex/Cursor/Gemini) background agent triggered from Linear, Slack, GitHub, GitLab

best_existing.name: Linear coding sessions
best_existing.covers: Assign a Linear issue to Linear Agent to run Claude Code or Codex in the cloud and return a diff

shortcomings.what: Claude Code on the web still connects only to GitHub; GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps requests remain open
Linear coding sessions require a GitHub connection; no other forge mentioned
GitLab external agents require Premium/Ultimate, are behind a feature flag enabled on request, and are 'Experiment' on Self-Managed/Dedicated
Cursor Azure DevOps and Bitbucket Cloud support is public beta, Bitbucket Data Center unsupported for cloud agents
User report: Cursor Azure DevOps integration broken
User report: Cursor cloud agents cannot get branches from Bitbucket repo
Codex cloud has no Azure DevOps integration

note: GitLab-side external agents, Cursor cloud agents and Cyrus let teams start agent work from non-GitHub forges and Linear. Coverage is still partial: the Claude Code/Codex cloud products stay GitHub-only, ADO/Bitbucket support is beta with failure reports, and GitLab's option is tier-gated.

best_existing.name: Claude Code native remote MCP OAuth (claude mcp login, --client-id/--client-secret, auto refresh)
best_existing.covers: Pre-registered client credentials for servers without DCR, refresh-and-retry on 401, offline_access, headless URL paste flow

best_existing.name: punkpeye/mcp-remote
best_existing.covers: Local stdio proxy that runs the OAuth flow and token refresh for remote MCP servers

best_existing.name: abluva/mcp-remote
best_existing.covers: Bridge for remote MCP with OAuth and auth recovery

best_existing.name: hyprmcp/mcp-gateway
best_existing.covers: MCP OAuth proxy including dynamic client registration

shortcomings.what: Codex does not auto-refresh MCP OAuth tokens even when a refresh token is stored (open)
Codex mcp login fails for Slack's official MCP: dynamic client registration not supported (open)
Codex OAuth fails at issuer validation (open)
Codex desktop: MCP sign-in never surfaces for plugin servers
Claude Code: concurrent processes wipe MCP OAuth entries from the macOS Keychain despite valid refresh tokens
Claude Code: plugin MCP OAuth is per-session and not durable
Claude Code: MCP OAuth against Microsoft Entra ID fails on connect/reconnect
Non-interactive runs (claude -p, Agent SDK) cannot run the OAuth flow, so scheduled automations still need a manual login
Third-party audit lists OAuth trust-boundary advisories/CVE records against mcp-remote

note: Claude Code's native OAuth and proxies like mcp-remote cover DCR gaps and refresh, but open bugs show token loss, per-session auth, IdP-specific failures and no headless re-auth, and Codex still lacks refresh and DCR fallbacks.

best_existing.name: Claude Code Read/Edit deny rules applied to recognized Bash file commands, plus OS sandbox
best_existing.covers: Deny rules cover cat/head/tail/sed/tee in Bash; sandbox blocks file access at OS level

best_existing.name: HabibiCodeCH/claude-no-bash-detour
best_existing.covers: PreToolUse hooks that deny Bash commands with a native-tool equivalent (grep/find, sed -i, cat/head/tail) and redirect to Grep/Glob/Read/Edit

best_existing.name: derekwden-droid/file-tools-first
best_existing.covers: Plugin blocking shell file reads/edits and routing them to Read/Edit/Write so /rewind and rules apply

best_existing.name: JasonGDG/claude-bash-bridge
best_existing.covers: Fires Write/Edit hooks and path rules when Claude edits files through Bash

shortcomings.what: In auto mode the harness itself instructs Claude to do file reads/writes via Bash (cat, sed, heredocs) instead of Read/Edit/Write; open
Model frequently uses sed/grep/cat when built-in tools fit; open
Checkpointing/rewind does not track files changed only by Bash commands
Read deny rules bypassed by grep -r and python one-liners on v2.1.285 unless the sandbox is on

note: Permission enforcement for shell file access is partly covered (deny rules on recognized commands, sandbox), and small hook projects redirect to file tools. Edit tracking, diffs and rewind are still bypassed, and the vendor's own auto-mode prompt pushes the behavior. The hook projects have little adoption.

best_existing.covers: Sets where plan-mode plan files are written, e.g. a plans/ directory in the repo (behaviour summarized in https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/89291)

best_existing.name: github/spec-kit
best_existing.covers: Spec-driven workflow that writes specs and plans into versioned, numbered directories in the repo across many agents

best_existing.name: humblefool-2/plan-checklist
best_existing.covers: Skill saving a plan as a markdown checklist in the project and resuming it in a new session

shortcomings.what: Plan filenames are still auto-generated (prompt slug plus random words); only the location is configurable
plansDirectory in global settings ignored by plan mode on 2.1.301 (earlier report closed as stale)
Per-repo plan naming scheme request remains open

note: plansDirectory can put plans in the repo and spec-kit or small mods/skills enforce in-repo naming. The native naming scheme is still not configurable and the setting has reliability bugs, and the plan-naming mods have no adoption yet.

best_existing.name: Dicklesworthstone/destructive_command_guard
best_existing.covers: PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive shell/git/filesystem commands (e.g. git reset --hard, rm -rf) before agents run them

best_existing.name: kenryu42/cc-safety-net
best_existing.covers: Pre-execution guard blocking destructive git and filesystem commands for coding agents

best_existing.name: CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR
best_existing.covers: Returns the Bash tool to the original working directory after each command in the main session

shortcomings.what: Core report that Claude Code loses track of its directory is still open
The cwd-reset variable is opt-in and applies only to the main session, not subagents
Guards decide by command pattern, not whether the target is the intended directory; cc-safety-net missed git -C <abs path> when cwd was outside the repo
cc-safety-net fix applied only when cwd was home; from a project cwd the same delete was allowed
destructive_command_guard decisions vary with cwd and produce false positives

note: Popular guard hooks stop the catastrophic case (destructive git/rm) and an env var pins the shell cwd, but nothing makes the agent reliably track where it is. The guards check command patterns rather than whether the target directory is the intended one.

shortcomings.what: Claude Code scheduled tasks (routines) belong to an individual account, are not shared with teammates, and act as the creator's GitHub/Slack identity
Shared routines feature request remains open
claude-code-action fails auth when triggered by cron while manual runs work (open)
Headless action reports success after the agent backgrounds work, so scheduled CI runs silently do nothing
Team members got Access Forbidden on agents spawned by team-owned Cursor automations until VM Sharing was enabled

note: Team ownership exists in Cursor Automations, and CI-based runners (claude-code-action, gh-aw, codex-action) give repo-owned schedules. Claude Code's own scheduled tasks are still per-user, and the CI route has open cron-auth and silent-success bugs.
